info.headline: Mahanadi delta: flooding expected at a Naraj flow of 32,997 m3/s
info.description: MAHANADI DELTA - EXPECTED FLOODING FOR A NARAJ FLOW OF 32,997 m3/s (11.7 lakh cusec), lead time 24 h (flow = highest daily flow over 5 days at Naraj, the measure the atlas is fitted on; method: trigger-discharge map, river flow only) Expected flooded land: 216 km2 (lower bound: flow above the largest in the 2017-2026 radar record) People living on that land: 25,163 Settlements with at least 10 % of people on flooded land: 24 - near Patkura (9.7 km): about 354 people (50% of 704) at 20.3133 N, 86.3615 E - near Biridi (1.4 km): about 309 people (54% of 574) at 20.3319 N, 86.0429 E - near Bhattasagar Square (7.0 km): about 247 people (15% of 1,613) at 20.6301 N, 86.1248 E - near Patkura (7.3 km): about 243 people (14% of 1,763) at 20.3304 N, 86.3768 E - near Patkura (8.5 km): about 160 people (13% of 1,205) at 20.3190 N, 86.3756 E - near Patkura (5.9 km): about 155 people (12% of 1,349) at 20.3416 N, 86.3819 E - near Patkura (2.7 km): about 152 people (24% of 647) at 20.4002 N, 86.3823 E - near Patkura (9.3 km): about 96 people (36% of 269) at 20.3113 N, 86.3760 E - near Patkura (1.5 km): about 78 people (28% of 281) at 20.3855 N, 86.3917 E - near Dhuria (8.6 km): about 76 people (14% of 529) at 20.4610 N, 86.3444 E - near Choudwar (4.0 km): about 75 people (11% of 694) at 20.5588 N, 85.8918 E - near Fakirabad (6.7 km): about 74 people (11% of 679) at 20.4574 N, 86.3759 E - near Patkura (14.6 km): about 71 people (16% of 440) at 20.2606 N, 86.4338 E - near Patkura (10.8 km): about 68 people (28% of 247) at 20.3116 N, 86.3447 E - near Patkura (9.1 km): about 68 people (27% of 253) at 20.3116 N, 86.4309 E Main roads under water: 12.7 km Source: Sentinel-1 flood atlas 2017-2026 + GloFAS discharge (IIT Bombay IDP prototype). Not an official warning.
info.instruction: Follow the district administration; keep off flooded roads.
